title: Reserving, waiting and sharing a table

text: In a restaurant you often wait to be seated, especially in the evening. In a busy café or pub, though, it is normal to ask Ist hier noch frei? ("Is this seat free?") and sit at a table with strangers. At the Stammtisch, a regulars' table, you should only sit if you are invited.
To reserve a table, say how many people, which day and under which name.
